crossRefs.note: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall…
Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

translations.web: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translations.bsb: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
translations.asv: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbor's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
